changes.change: Add explicit exact_anchor_index between authoritative stores and semantic graph; anchors point to truth but do not become authority.
changes.expected_benefit: Prevents associative projection from laundering approximate/derived memory into exact state.

changes.change: Reify meaning-bearing statements with temporal/provenance/epistemic envelope and conflict sets.
changes.expected_benefit: Preserve source stance, stale/revoked/superseded alternatives and temporal validity.

changes.change: Default two-hop broad propagation to conservative qualified one-hop expansion; weak edges require target lexical/vector support or query intent.
changes.expected_benefit: Reduce irrelevant activation/false association while retaining relation recovery.

changes.change: Classify exact/current vs associative queries; require exact-anchor fetch for authority/current-state decisions.
changes.expected_benefit: Combine semantic recall with deterministic current truth.

changes.change: Adaptive incremental projection with deterministic rebuild fallback on unknown/wide dependency closure.
changes.expected_benefit: Exploit incremental view maintenance when beneficial without assuming incremental always wins.

changes.change: Map ClayGraph primarily into M.MEMORY_FABRIC while keeping M.DURABLE_EVENT_STATE, CognitiveFrame and CapabilityGateway exact and authoritative.
changes.expected_benefit: Integrate associative memory without changing core safety/causal contracts.

predicted_regressions: More assertion/provenance metadata increases storage and update cost.
Qualified one-hop expansion can miss useful longer paths.
Exact-anchor fetches can add latency vs graph-only answers.
Reification can make simple relations more expensive.
Hybrid lexical/vector/graph paths increase operational complexity.

contradictions.resolution: semantic unification only; physical merge is store-specific and evidence-gated

contradictions.issue: broad spreading activation vs false association
contradictions.resolution: candidate narrows default propagation; longer expansion is explicit/query-scoped

contradictions.issue: current graph protocol asks complete current corpus but runtime materialization is unavailable
contradictions.resolution: HOLD; seven-branch coverage/manual proxy performed, no claim of full runtime benchmark
